decisions.reason: The charting plugin is established and integrated into the map.apps offering, so it remains valuable to customers and unlikely to be withdrawn in the next year.
The mobile layer control component supports the firm's mobile GIS solutions and was prominently featured, indicating it still contributes to the firm's mobile strategy.
As the flagship software platform with multiple product-line models, it is central to the firm's enterprise GIS direction and would be retained under almost all circumstances.
